```{=html}
<script>
// The Categories filter (right margin) filters the Everything tab only: show it on that tab.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  const tabs = document.querySelector(".overview .panel-tabset");
  if (!tabs) return;   // the family site has no tabs: the list and its filter are always shown
  function update() {
    const on = tabs.querySelector(".nav-link.active");
    document.body.classList.toggle("ov-filters-off", !on || on.textContent.trim() !== "Everything");
  }
  tabs.addEventListener("shown.bs.tab", update);
  update();
});

// The chips above the units show only one kind of document; a unit with none of that kind is hidden.
document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
  const chip = e.target.closest(".ov-chip");
  if (!chip) return;
  const bar = chip.parentElement, f = chip.dataset.f;
  bar.querySelectorAll(".ov-chip").forEach(function (c) { c.classList.toggle("ov-on", c === chip); });
  let el = bar.closest(".cell-output-display, .tab-pane") || document;
  el.querySelectorAll(".ov-unit").forEach(function (unit) {
    let shown = 0;
    unit.querySelectorAll(".ov-item").forEach(function (row) {
      row.hidden = f !== "all" && row.dataset.f !== f;
      if (!row.hidden) shown++;
    });
    unit.hidden = f !== "all" && shown === 0;
  });
});
</script>
```
